description: This line plot illustrates how the minimum FDE20 metric, measured in meters, changes across different values of the ratio parameter, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 on a linear scale, for five different methods: TrajICL, Head Tuning, FT, LoRA 16, and LoRA 64. The y-axis, labeled "minFDE20 (m)", spans from 18 to 23 on a linear scale. The TrajICL method is represented by a solid blue line with circular markers, showing a consistent decline from approximately 20.5 at a ratio of 0.0 to 18.0 at a ratio of 1.0. The Head Tuning method is depicted by an orange line with circular markers, starting near 23.0 and generally decreasing slightly to around 22.5. The FT method is shown by a green line with circular markers, beginning at approximately 22.3, dipping to 21.8 around a ratio of 0.4, and then rising to about 21.1 at a ratio of 1.0. The LoRA 16 method is represented by a red line with circular markers, starting near 23.0 and decreasing to approximately 22.1 at a ratio of 1.0. The LoRA 64 method is shown by a purple line with circular markers, beginning near 23.0 and decreasing to approximately 22.1 at a ratio of 1.0.
